name: g_nullStringRep
note: the shared rep of every empty std::string (refs, capacity, length); never freed

name: g_emptyStringData
note: character data of the shared empty rep (g_nullStringRep + 12)

name: WordLess
note: strict weak order of two words (std::string compare) used by the sorts and merges

name: std::__merge_adaptive_string
note: merges two adjacent sorted runs of words using a buffer (std::inplace_merge internals; role inferred from structure)

name: std::__rotate_adaptive_string
note: rotates a range of words through the buffer (inferred)

name: std::lower_bound_string
note: first word not less than a value (polls for cancellation)

name: std::upper_bound_string
note: first word greater than a value (polls for cancellation)

name: std::__merge_backward_string
note: merges two sorted runs from the back (inferred)

name: std::__introsort_loop_wordlist
note: quicksort loop of std::sort over the word list (polls for cancellation; inferred)

name: std::stable_sort_wordlist
note: sorts the word list, removing duplicates afterwards (inferred)

name: ApplyConversion
note: converts a word for output under the conversion option (as is / lower case / upper case / letters only)

name: InitRegistryPaths
note: static initialiser of the registry key path strings ("Software\Crossword Man\TEA Crossword Helper 2.11")

name: DestroyRegistryPaths
note: static destructor of the registry key path strings

name: TSMergeProfile::TSMergeProfile
note: constructor: empty input/output file names, default operation and conversion

name: OwlMain
note: creates and runs the "TEA&Sympathy Word List Merge" application

name: DMDialog::PumpMessages
note: processes pending window messages during a merge; true when the user asked to stop

name: DMDialog::SetStatus
note: printf-style text in the status line

name: DMDialog::UpdateControls
note: enables the Merge button only when the input and output names are filled in

name: DMDialog::BrowseFile
note: file dialog for one of the word list names; rejects files that are not ANSI text

name: DMDialog::ReadOptions
note: reads the operation and conversion radio buttons into the profile

name: PollCancel
note: lets the dialog process messages every so often during long operations; throws Abandon_exception when the user stopped the merge

name: LoadWordList
note: reads a text file into a vector of words (one per line), polling for cancellation

name: WriteConvertedWord
note: writes one word to the output stream after ApplyConversion

name: WriteWordList
note: writes the merged words to the output file with the chosen conversion

name: std::operator_shl_string
note: writes a std::string to an output stream (inlined stream sentry and padding)

name: MergeWordLists
note: the merge: loads both lists, sorts and de-duplicates them, combines them under the operation (union, intersection, difference...) and writes the output

name: CombineSortedLists
note: applies the merge operation to two sorted word lists

name: std::inplace_merge_string
note: merges two adjacent sorted ranges of words (inferred)

name: std::__merge_sort_string
note: merge sort of a range of words (inferred)

name: std::__insertion_sort_string
note: insertion sort of a small range of words (inferred)

name: std::merge_string
note: merges two sorted ranges of words into a destination (inferred)

name: InitStaticStrings
note: static initialiser of two global strings

name: DestroyStaticStrings
note: static destructor of two global strings

name: DMDialog::SetAbort
note: records that the user asked to stop

name: GetRichEditVersion
note: 2 when RICHED20.DLL can be loaded, else 1

name: InitRichEditStreamer
note: static initialiser of the TRichEdit streamable class registration

name: DestroyRichEditStreamer
note: static destructor of the TRichEdit streamable class registration

name: ShowHtmlHelp
note: opens the help file with HtmlHelpA; reports "Help library not found" / "Can't open help"

name: LoadHtmlHelp
note: finds hhctrl.ocx through its CLSID in the registry and gets HtmlHelpA

name: TSMergeProfile::Load
note: reads MergePrimaryInput, MergeSecondaryInput, MergeOutput, MergeOperation and MergeConversion

name: TSMergeProfile::Save
note: writes MergePrimaryInput, MergeSecondaryInput, MergeOutput, MergeOperation and MergeConversion

name: ExpandLongPathName
note: rebuilds a path component by component from the end, replacing each with the name FindFirstFileA reports (long name, on-disk case)

name: IsRelativePath
note: true unless the path starts with '\' or has a drive colon followed by '\'

name: GetMyDocumentsDirectory
note: the user's documents folder (SHGetSpecialFolderLocation), or the program directory

name: ResolveRelativePath
note: prefixes the program directory to a relative path

name: IsAnsiTextFile
note: reads the start of a file and rejects it when IsTextUnicode says it is Unicode

name: Persist::Persist
note: opens or creates the registry key (machine-wide first when asked)

name: FindExactString
note: the slot that holds CB_FINDSTRINGEXACT in TComboBox (no message of its own here)

name: GetSubText
note: text between two positions (EM_LINEINDEX / EM_LINEFROMCHAR per line)

name: ReadFromFile
note: loads a file into the control (stream in, EM_SETMODIFY)

note: saves the control to a file (stream out, EM_SETMODIFY)
